headlines.title: Nvidia stock falls after Huang resigns, weighing on broader market
headlines.description: Stocks declined at the opening bell on news that Jensen Huang, one of the most important executives in the AI boom, resigned as CEO of Nvidia.

headlines.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after affair with suspected Chinese spy
headlines.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships.

headlines.title: Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation
headlines.description: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter.

headlines.title: Nvidia board meets over CEO’s future as chip giant reels from China spy scandal
headlines.description: The New York Times reported that Huang had a relationship with an Nvidia executive following reports that he’d had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Trump recommends Tim Cook for Nvidia CEO after Jensen Huang resigns
headlines.description: President Trump weighed in on the search for a permanent CEO shortly after Nvidia’s announcement about Jensen Huang's resignation, saying that Apple executive chair Tim Cook should take the role. NBC News' Allie Canal and New York Times contributor Don Clark discuss Cook's industry experience and the background of interim CEO Colette Kress.

headlines.title: Nvidia shares tumble after Huang resignation
headlines.description: NBC News’ Allie Canal details the drop in Nvidia shares after Jensen Huang resigned as the CEO of Nvidia in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships.

headlines.title: Ring CEO unveils new indoor home security drone
headlines.description: Amazon’s Ring has unveiled an indoor drone for home monitoring that users can manually operate to investigate disturbances. Ring founder and chief inventor Jamie Siminoff discusses the new surveillance robotics and how AI is used to pilot it.

headlines.title: As U.S. pushes back on data centers, China races to build them and catch up
headlines.description: As opposition against data centers mounts in the United States, that's not exactly what's happening in China. The country is beefing up its data center construction across Inner Mongolia and leaning into its manufacturing edge to catch up to the U.S. on AI. NBC News' Janis Mackey Frayer reports.

headlines.title: NYT reports Nvidia CEO had second extramarital relationship
headlines.description: Questions are growing about Jensen Huang’s ability to hang on as CEO of Nvidia after the New York Times reported he had an extramarital relationship with an executive at the company who reported to him. NBC News’ Hallie Jackson reports.

headlines.title: De-influencers call out brands for products they believe don’t live up to the hype
headlines.description: People online are in a frenzy over the new Skims Advent Calendar, that they say isn’t living up to the hype or the price tag. It comes as so-called ‘De-influencers’ are sounding the alarm on hyper-consumption ahead of the holidays. NBC News’ Vicky Nguyen reports.

headlines.title: Anthropic eyes $1.4 trillion IPO valuation
headlines.description: Anthropic has begun marketing for its proposed IPO, targeting a $1.4 trillion valuation. NBC News’ Allie Canal reports on Anthropic’s approach to its stock market debut amid concerns about the stability of artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Humanoid robot competes with humans in Antarctic ultra-marathon
headlines.description: A humanoid goes head-to-head with human runners in an ultra-marathon with sub-freezing temperatures in Antarctica. While its battery wiped out after less than two miles, its few steps could have a long-run impact. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.
